sourceAccessLimits: Completed author reads, not preparation inferred as inspection. Prior segments actually read all13 original family chunks,20 complete public captures and30 complete component records. The immediately preceding segment actually read all15 original older-body chunks,134 navigation records, two supplemental family chunks and three supplemental older-body chunks.

Original309/728 and supplemental29/90 captures share one three-sense family; the unique union is337 complete families/815 senses. Original126 and supplemental25 complete older articles are disjoint:151 unique bodies. Ninety labels additionally come from those actually read full-body front matters.

All33 generated family/old-body chunks are16000UTF8 bytes or less. Preparation plans honestly retain prepared_for_inspection; this separate completed-inspection record advances actual-read bookkeeping.
Twenty positive public captures are Digital Daijisen through Weblio: one dictionary authority, not20 independent sources, fresh reviewer retrievals, measured frequencies or a native-speaker review.

Mixed public headings were adjudicated by exact spelling/reading: modern 殴る versus preceding unrelated classical material; modern なす versus archaic せす; modern fruit-bearing なる versus archaic ある and historical broader 生じる. A successful fetch is not wholesale verification of all returned headings.

Raw empty なだらか gloss and erroneous minutes gloss for なにぶん are preserved. Selected meanings come from exact pinned families and matching public entries; separate なんぷん1189320 is not silently substituted.

Twenty new articles preserve all baseline identities, readings, titles, levels, exclusions and bodies. Shared1212670 membership did not establish tame-sense coverage in existing N4慣れる; bounded馴れる teaches sense3 without changing that older article.

Kana source identitiesなぐる/なにしろ retain empty primary kanji arrays while their written forms are explicitly explained. Every Han in a primary written identity is retained even where the character card is absent.

Quiz declarations are author hypotheses for direct symmetric nontransitive pairs. Full labels, complete older bodies and ordinary secondary senses were inspected; no exhaustive corpus-wide ambiguity audit, live-quiz guarantee or independent agreement is claimed.

quizGuardRationale: Evaluate all declared edges independently, not by inheriting a neighboring clique. Direct ordinary secondary senses count, including shared friendship, doing/committing, gradual smoothness, request/quantity, following/copying and sound/music uses.
Do not exempt noun/verb or state/change pairs automatically. Compare both actual meanings and displayed labels; exact-title equality already deduplicates.
Homophony alone does not justify a guard: 無くす/亡くす, 習う/倣う and becomingなる/fruit-bearing生る are kept distinct. Broader loss失う explicitly covers bereavement; 別れる also has a death-separation sense.
何分's quantity/request/reason functions require separate direct consideration; their declared neighbors do not imply exclusions between every two quantity/request/reason neighbors.

なだらか's physical/gradual/process/tone ranges and older mimetics require sense-specific checks. Shared smooth/gentle English alone may overstate an edge; reviewers must assess excesses as well as omissions.
The botanical production event is not the picked crop or fruit referent; tree rows are not every grove or line. Those topic/category relationships alone do not justify exclusions.
